Site copy (Nov 3, Phase 0 of the results view): four fields added beside each row. `label` is the short name of the office its button names ("Travis County results"). `counties` names the counties a county row covers, spelled as data/places/*.json spell them. `official_by` is the last day the row's results must be made official, read from `certification_date` (the legal deadline where a scheduled date comes earlier), or null when the text gives none. `official_by_sure` is false when the registry calls that date computed, calculated, tentative, unverified, conflicting or "about"; the guide shows only sure dates and says results are official only when every sure date on a ballot has passed.
